origin.rerun: python3 scripts/backtest_trend.py --symbol CL --data <CL futures candle file> ... # then re-run scripts/research/prop_ev_sim.py on the resulting trades.jsonl with --swap-model prorated

what: [W6/B6] uso_trend_1h alone clears RULE-B6-PROP-EV-PER-ACCOUNT-LIFE-V2 (evidence-CI p5=+$42.7, n=56) when mapped to Breakout's CL symbol, but the evidence is priced off USO ETF data, and USO is a documented poor proxy for WTI/CL futures under contango (its methodology rolls near-month contracts and has diverged materially from spot/futures WTI, most visibly in 2020).
